### TC.MonitorTouch

A selected monitor character cell was activated through the supported player
interaction. Coordinates are terminal cells, not world tiles or mosaic pixels.

Extends: TC.MonitorEvent

### name

Touch event discriminator.

```text
'monitor_touch'
```

### player_index

Activating player index, not a player object.

```text
integer
```

### sample_tick

Original synchronized monitor activation tick.

```text
TC.Tick
```

### x

One-based character column.

```text
integer
```

### y

One-based character row.

```text
integer
```
